# GlotChat

> Windows desktop app that runs multiple WhatsApp accounts in one window — each isolated with its own notifications — and translates messages, voice notes and photos offline in 49 languages.

GlotChat is a Windows desktop app. It opens the official WhatsApp Web for each account in its own isolated session and adds offline translation of messages, voice notes and text in photos. It is an independent product, not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Accounts: tested with 27 WhatsApp accounts at the same time; each uses about 300–450 MB of memory
- Translation: 49 languages, offline on the user's PC; voice notes recognised in about 100 languages
- Free trial: 3 days, every feature, no payment — starts with one click in the app ("Start my free 3-day trial"), one trial per computer
- Download (Windows installer, version 1.2.6, 381 MB): https://download.glotchat.com/GlotChat-Setup-1.2.6.exe — install guide: https://www.glotchat.com/download/
- Prices (per year, paid in USDT TRC20 · BEP20 · ERC20): Starter 69 USDT (up to 5 accounts, 1 PC), Pro 129 USDT (up to 15 accounts, 1 PC), Business 249 USDT (unlimited accounts, 3 PCs)
- Contact / purchase: Telegram https://t.me/GlotChat
- Website languages: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, العربية, Türkçe, Español, Português, Русский
